descriptionText:
This 2008 Upper Deck First Edition Starquest Common #SQ-36 trading card features Carlos Beltran, a former Major League Baseball player for the New York Mets. The card is a standard size and was manufactured by Upper Deck in 2008. It is a sports trading card with parallel and variety features, and is part of the Starquest insert set. 

The card is not autographed and is perfect for collectors of baseball memorabilia. It is a great addition to any collection and is a must-have for fans of Carlos Beltran and the New York Mets. Get your hands on this 2008 Upper Deck First Edition Starquest Common #SQ-36 trading card today!
